Gujarati Printing Press
------------------------------------------
This is one of the oldest printing presses in India that has also published invaluable works bearing on philosophy and religion.
It was started by Fardunjee Marzban (A.

at Bombay (now Mumbai).
Started first as a book binding shop it was later developed into a printing press and a publishing होउसे.
It published the Zoroastrian चलेन्दर् in A.
and the newspaper Bombay Samachar in A.

in the Gujarati language. This newspaper continues to this day, making it one of the oldest, continuously printed newspaper, in the world.
This press, over the years, has published many extremely valuable scriptures of हिन्दुइस्म् with commentaries and translations.
By far, the most outstanding contribution of this institution is the publication of the Rāmāyaṇa of वाल्मीकि with three standard commentaries.
